summary: Frontend-only test of (1) Gantt PDF/PNG export buttons on Régime A Parcours A and Régime B francisation (Module 2), and (2) new PORTEFEUILLE PRO page with Gantt/Kanban toggle. All acceptance criteria PASS. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: ExportGanttButton is small, focused and reusable (good DRY). Note: iconography — lucide's 'Image' export collides with the HTML Image constructor name if ever used outside JSX; harmless here but consider aliasing (e.g. import { Image as ImageIcon }).

PortefeuillePro.jsx: filter regimeB=(regime!=='A') is correct here since PRO consultant has only Régime B dossiers, but semantically stricter would be regime==='B' to future-proof if other regimes appear.
PortfolioKanban: cards on 'Inscription' column display 'retard 157 j' in red for many dossiers; expected given seeded overdue dates. Not a bug.

Click on a portfolio-gantt-grid-bar-<id> navigates to /dossier/<id>. (b) SOLO Régime B login -> nav-portefeuille count=0, direct GET /portefeuille redirects away (stayed on prior /dossier/<id>). (c) Gantt FR export: clicked gantt-export-pdf & gantt-export-png, network responses GET .../gantt/export?kind=francisation&format=pdf -> 200 application/pdf, format=png -> 200 image/png; toast 'Gantt exporté (PDF/PNG)' shown. 3 gantt-fr-grid-bar-* bars still rendered (non-regression OK).
